09:44 - 16:49 means time A minus time B, computed as (9:44) - (16:49).  
Convert to minutes: 9:44 = 9*60 + 44 = 584 minutes.  
16:49 = 16*60 + 49 = 1009 minutes.  
584 - 1009 = -425 minutes.  
Add 24 hours (1440 minutes): -425 + 1440 = 1015 minutes.  
1015 minutes = 16 hours 55 minutes → 16:55.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 16:55
